inv.desc_en:
Attention investors;

Retail sells a profitable commercial property at 6.67% annually, on Leganitos street a few meters from Gran Vía street, in the heart of the Centro district. A very touristy area of Madrid with high pedestrian and vehicular traffic.

Characteristics:

- Surface area: 245.83 m² in total, divided into 212.83 m² on the ground floor and 33 m² in the basement.

- 5 linear meter facade.

- Height: 3 meters.

- Smoke extraction: YES.

Call us to arrange an investment meeting at our offices and we will provide you with more information.

We have more commercial properties on the most commercial streets throughout Madrid.
